description: This file contains documentation and hook implementations related to the Drupal JSON:API module, including access control, filtering, and resource management.

methods.name: hook_jsonapi_entity_filter_access
methods.description: Controls access when filtering by entity data via JSON:API, granting permissions based on entity type and user permissions.

methods.name: hook_jsonapi_ENTITY_TYPE_filter_access
methods.description: Entity-type-specific access control for filtering entity data, e.g., for 'llamas'.

methods.name: hook_jsonapi_entity_field_filter_access
methods.description: Restricts filtering access to specific sensitive fields based on user permissions.
